items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Eddie Dawson. Eddie Dawson. Yeah, yeah. He stopped playing music. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I think he's one of those Jehovah's Witnesses.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think with George for about four years playing a different place. And then I went with Chester's Otis. Little Chester's Otis. He played bass player. He had a group with me and Howard Mandorf and Alexis Russel. You might have heard him. He's a saxophone player.
He's working with Whitney Bank there, the messenger. The same place that the bass player lived on. Eddie Dawson. Eddie Dawson. Yeah, yeah. He stopped playing music.
Yeah, I think he's one of those Jehovah's Witnesses.
